SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Ability
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the question as to whether living beings have the ability to carry out a certain activity or not, either as a result of a physical disability or due to another cause or reason.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Access
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the question whether certain locations are accessible or not.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Action
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: This contextual domain is only used in extensions of meaning, such as Body > Action. It covers cases where a part of the body is used to denote the action that it performs. The expression "God's hand", for example, can be used to describe hardship and suffering

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Adoption
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms related to the process by which humans officially accept a child that is not their direct offspring as theirs.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Affection
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the degree of affection between individuals or groups that have a certain relationship together

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Age
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to age and everything that is associated with it, such as wisdom, status, grey hair, weakness of body, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Aggression
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people and deities performing acts of aggression to other people

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Agriculture
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to agriculture

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Alcohol
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to alcoholic beverages and the effect they have on those who consume them

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Animal
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to animal behavior

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Animal Husbandry
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the context of people keeping domestic animals for a living

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Anointing
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the process of anointing people to formally commission them to take on a certain role.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Apparition
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to appearances of supernatural beings and the way humans respond to that

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Assembly
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to communities of people being assembled for religious and other purposes

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Authority
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the relationship between someone in authority and the people entrusted to their care.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Beauty
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to physical beauty.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Behavior
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to one's mode of conduct or behavior, which is often depicted as a metaphorical journey.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Blessing and Cursing
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to humans and deities pronouncing a blessing or a curse on both animate and inanimate objects, including the consequences thereof.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Body
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the body of animals and human being, including all related natural processes.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Bribery
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the process by which humans pay others to receive favors and services that should be available for free.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Building

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Burial
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to funerals and burial and all rituals surrounding these events

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Cannibalism

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Calendar

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Care and Neglect
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the way people and deities take care of the needs of others and themselves.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Census

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Chaos

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Crafts

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Creation
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to God's creation of heaven and earth.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Childbirth

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Circumcision

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Citizen vs. Foreigner

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Clothing

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Color

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Commerce

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Compassion
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to compassion and cruelty.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Competition
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people striving for superiority in a certain field.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Control
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to different individuals or parties in control of others, outside of the regular and legal path of Authority

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Communication
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to efforts of deities, people, and animals to communicate among themselves and with others, either or not verbally.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Community
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to groups of people with a common ancestor or coming from one single area

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Confidence and Fear
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to confidence and fear,

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Conflict
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to conflicts, including their consequences, and efforts to come to a resolution.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Construction
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to buildings and other construction, including the processes of building.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Covenant
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to covenants, including all rituals and stipulations.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Courts and Legal Procedures
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to courts and legal procedures where conflicts are settled and crimes are punished.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Decoration
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the decoration of objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Destruction
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the destruction of objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Divine
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to God and other supernatural beings, their characteristics and activities.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Dreaming
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms related to people experiencing dreams while asleep

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Drought
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to a prolonged absence or rain and its consequences for the land and the people living there

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Entertainment
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms related to people entertaining others or themselves

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Errand
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people in authority sending other people on an errand

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Euphemism
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms used as part of euphemisms.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Exile

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Exorcism
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to exorcism.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Faithfulness

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Family

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Fasting
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people abstaining from food for religious and other purposes.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Festival
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to official religious celebrations, such as Shabbat, New Moon, Passover, Sukkoth, etc.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Fire

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Food

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Forgiveness

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Freedom and Bondage

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Genealogy

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Generosity and Greed
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people's willingness to give to others.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Geography
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the geography of the world.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Group
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to group behavior.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Hardship
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to suffering and hardship.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Health and Sickness
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to health and sickness, such as diseases, wounds, treatment, medication, healing, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Heights and Depths
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to of heights and depths, including people's efforts to climb up and down.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Hiding and Searching
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All contexts relating to people and things being hidden in secret locations, including efforts to revover them

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: History
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to history.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Holy and Common
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the question as to whether supernatural beings, humans, animals and objects belong to the realm of God or to the realm of ordinary humans.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Hospitality
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people receiving guests and their responsibilities towards them.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Household
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to a person's household and all related activities.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Human
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms referring to the realm of humans as contrasted to deities, animals, and inanimate objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Humility and Pride
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to attitudes of self-esteem, ranging from humble to proud

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Hunting and Fishing
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to hunting, fishing, and gathering

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Idolatry

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Incest

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Infrastructure
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to roads and other forms of infrastructure

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Insulting

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Irony
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: Frame of irony and sarcasm

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Journey
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of people traveling, either in groups or alone, including the preparations they make, their means or going (vehicle, donkey, horse), etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Joy and Grief
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the emotions of joy and grief

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Jubilee
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of the year of Jubilee

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Justice
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to justice and just behavior in government, court, and human relations

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Land

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Law
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of the law, both of God and of humans

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Life and Death
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the life span of animate objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Light and Darkness
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to light and darkness and what is in between

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of liquids and their behavior, such as flowing, pouring, freezing, etc. This frame partly overlaps with the frame of |uWater|u*, though the latter only deals with bodies of water found in nature

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Loan
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of a loan

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Magic
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of magic activities, such as sorcery, sorcery, casting spells, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Marriage
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to marriage

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Mining
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to mining

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Monument
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to monuments and other symbols used to commemorate important people or events

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Mourning
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to mourning, such as weeping, rending one's garments, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Motion
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to movement

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Nation
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to nations and their behavior; for relationships between nations, see: Politics

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Nature

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Navigation
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: Frame of navigation, including ships, sailors, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Nomad
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to nomadic people and their way of living, traveling, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Oath
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to taking oaths, vows, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Office
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to people working at a king's court

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Permanence
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame revolving around the question whether things or conditions last or not

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Parenthood
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of the relationship of parents towards their children

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Plague
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of plagues, such as epidemics, natural disasters, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Plan
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the process of making plans, whether good or evil

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Plant
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of plants, their behavior, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Pledge
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of giving or receiving securities for loans

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Politics
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of the relationships between nations

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Possession

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Posterity

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Prayer
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of people that are praying

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Priesthood
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of priests, their function, dress, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Prophecy

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Quality
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: Frame of quality

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Quantity

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Reality

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Refuge

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Respect
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of people showing respect for other people and/or their achievements

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Responsibility
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of responsibility for one's actions

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Representation
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to representation, such as objects representing people or other objects, or people representing a tribe, clan, or other family unit

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Royalty
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to kings, including their names, attributes, consecration rituals, privileges, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Security
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to feeling secure

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Secrecy
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame concerning the question whether certain knowledge is public or restricted

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Self
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All references to self; used primarily to denote relationships between humans or deities and and their selves.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Senses
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms involving the senses

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Sex

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Shape
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the shape of objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Shepherding

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Siege
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to a siege

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Size
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the size of objects

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Slander

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Slavery

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Sleeping
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to sleeping, dreaming, waking up, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Speed
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to speed

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Stances
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to stances of the body

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: State
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the physical state of an object, i.e. whether it is whole, divided, or impacted.

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Status

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Storage

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Strength
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to physical weakness and strength

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Success and Failure
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to the question whether certain actions fail or are successful

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Swimming
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to swimming

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Symbol
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to symbols

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Temper
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to someone's temper, including terms referring to patience

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Tent
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms relating to tents and other temporary constructions

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Testimony

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Town
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of a towns and other population centers, including everything that is part of it, such as walls, ramparts, gates, bars, etc

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Universe

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Value

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Warfare

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Water

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Writing

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Weather
SemanticDomainLocalizations.Description: All terms belonging to the frame of weather and climate; related to and partially overlapping with: Temperature, Wind

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Weeping

SemanticDomainLocalizations.Label: Work
